learning.title: Null-model reasoning as a transferable structural method
learning.summary: Compare observed trajectory against explicit plausible null trajectories before attributing causality, intervention effect, anomaly or mechanism.
learning.rule: For any domain with an observed delta, define one or more plausible nulls preserving relevant constraints; compare observed-vs-null before promoting causal or anomalous interpretation.
learning.provenance: Olympus NULL_MODEL_BASELINE → NEXO Integrity transfer test

learning.title: Frozen decision contract before target inspection
learning.summary: Define the statistic, parameter/search range, threshold and decision rule before inspecting the target outcome; any material extension becomes a new test rather than a post-hoc rescue.
learning.rule: Whenever an analysis can be tuned after seeing the result, freeze the admissible search/decision contract first and treat later expansions as separately preregistered tests.

learning.title: Independent holdout as adjudication channel
learning.summary: Evidence used to formulate, tune or select a claim should be separated from evidence used to adjudicate it; independent holdouts prevent the same information from both generating and confirming the claim.
learning.rule: When a hypothesis or model was selected on one evidence channel, require an independent instrument, release, tracer, dataset or untouched subset for promotion beyond exploratory support.

learning.title: Perturbation and invariance testing before claim promotion
learning.summary: A claim should be stress-tested under plausible changes in probe composition, selection, calibration, finder, numerical resolution or nuisance treatment; instability is evidence about the claim boundary, not noise to be averaged away.
learning.rule: For any promoted conclusion, identify plausible nuisance/selection/implementation perturbations and measure verdict stability; use LOO/ablation/sensitivity when full alternative pipelines are unavailable.

learning.title: Evidence-class claim boundary discipline
learning.summary: The strongest allowed claim is capped by the weakest unresolved evidentiary condition: operational failures are not scientific negatives, survival is not confirmation, unmatched data contracts cannot produce a global winner, and correlated evidence cannot be summed as independent support.
learning.rule: Before closing or promoting a result, map evidence class, unresolved gates, dependence structure and operational blockers to an explicit maximum claim boundary.

learning.title: Two-layer semantic/procedural associative network
learning.summary: Operational terms and procedures behave like nodes; observed outcomes update weighted filaments connecting semantic meaning, method, actions and domains.
learning.rule: Daily captures semantic signals; Core activates candidate filaments; Executor records method_used/outcome; Reconciler updates support/contradiction/weight and Atlas projects filaments.
learning.scope: Structural learning only; not science/health authority.

learning.title: Semantic meaning of 'nulls da dieta'
learning.summary: The phrase 'nulls da dieta' means rival-explanation audit for body-composition evolution, not a linear weight-loss forecast.
learning.rule: When Dener asks for diet nulls, activate rival explanations: fat loss, water/glycogen, lean mass loss, retention/inflammation, measurement error, partial adherence and recomposition.

crossDomain.title: Discovery-function fragility
crossDomain.summary: Post-selection, percolation-threshold sensitivity and un-replayed optimization inflate local rarity; independent physicality and discovery-aware global rarity are separate gates.
crossDomain.provenance: Formulation: GA/GR/Huge-LQG + Quipu; independent evidence: DS1 discovery + DESI LRG, HCBGW discovery.

crossDomain.title: Topology amplification
crossDomain.summary: Percolation/connectivity thresholds act nonlinearly near critical linkage scales: small density/selection perturbations reorganize connected components, candidate counts and conditioned significance.
crossDomain.provenance: Big Ring formulation; Giant Arc preregistered holdout; HCBGW preregistered cross-finder holdout.

crossDomain.title: Null-first auditing is a transferable semantic/procedural pattern
crossDomain.summary: Observed signal is ambiguous; build rival explanations first, compare with real trajectory/readback, then decide adjustment/claim.
crossDomain.provenance: User semantic correction 2026-09-09 + existing structural null model record.
